from hermes_tools import terminal, shell_quote
script = '''import importlib.util, json
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("task", "programs/task-891d4112.py")
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
def make(n, divs, marks):
 g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
 for i in divs:
  g[i]=[8]*n
  for r in range(n): g[r][i]=8
 for r,c,v in marks: g[r][c]=v
 return g
demo=make(22,[3,7,11,15,19],[(1,5,2),(17,5,2),(9,1,3),(9,17,3)])
out=m.transform(demo)
bounds=[-1,3,7,11,15,19,22]
expected=[[8 if demo[r][c]==8 else 0 for c in range(22)] for r in range(22)]
for i in range(6):
 for j in range(6):
  color=2 if j==1 and i<5 else 3 if i==2 and j<5 else 0
  if i==2 and j==1: color=6
  for r in range(bounds[i]+1,bounds[i+1]):
   for c in range(bounds[j]+1,bounds[j+1]): expected[r][c]=color
assert out==expected, "demo output mismatch"
test=make(28,[4,9,14,19,24],[(1,12,3),(6,2,2),(6,22,2),(16,2,2),(21,12,3)])
res=m.transform(test)
assert len(res)==28 and all(len(row)==28 for row in res)
print(json.dumps(res))
'''
